# Silver tables and views

<!-- Generated by `make docs-tables` from the schemas in analytics/pipelines/src/pipelines/schemas/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Silver holds one append-only Iceberg table of versions per source table, and two views over it: `<entity>_history`, the versions that changed the row with their validity range, and `<entity>_current`, the latest version. **Type** is the Spark SQL type. **Nullable** `no` means the pipeline always writes a value; Iceberg itself declares every lake column nullable.

## silver.customers

Customers who place orders. Append-only version history of source table customers: one row per change, never updated or removed; the input of the gold layer

Partitioned by day of `_changed_at`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | bigint | no | Customer identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `customer_name` | string | no | Name of the customer |
| `is_active` | boolean | no | Whether the customer is active |
| `customer_address` | string | yes | Address of the customer |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | yes | Time the source row was last updated (source wall clock read as UTC) |
| `updated_by` | bigint | yes | Identifier of the user who last updated the source row |
| `created_at` | timestamp | yes | Time the source row was created (source wall clock read as UTC) |
| `created_by` | bigint | yes | Identifier of the user who created the source row |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_change_op` | string | no | Kind of change: create, update, delete or snapshot (Debezium op c, u, d or r) |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |
| `_content_hash` | string | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |

Customers who place orders. Current state of source table customers: the current version of every row that is not deleted in the source

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `_change_op` | string | no | Kind of change: create, update, delete or snapshot (Debezium op c, u, d or r) |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |

## silver.customers_history

Customers who place orders. Version history of source table customers: one row per change that changed the row, with its validity range; a version with the same content and deletion state as the previous one is folded into it

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | bigint | no | Customer identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `customer_name` | string | no | Name of the customer |
| `is_active` | boolean | no | Whether the customer is active |
| `customer_address` | string | yes | Address of the customer |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | yes | Time the source row was last updated (source wall clock read as UTC) |
| `updated_by` | bigint | yes | Identifier of the user who last updated the source row |
| `created_at` | timestamp | yes | Time the source row was created (source wall clock read as UTC) |
| `created_by` | bigint | yes | Identifier of the user who created the source row |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_change_op` | string | no | Kind of change: create, update, delete or snapshot (Debezium op c, u, d or r) |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |
| `_content_hash` | string | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |
| `_valid_from` | timestamp | no | Time this version of the row became current: the change's commit time in the source |
| `_valid_to` | timestamp | yes | Time the next version of the row replaced this one; null while this version is current |
| `_is_current` | boolean | no | Whether this is the latest version of the row |

## silver.orders

Orders placed by customers, with their status and dates. Append-only version history of source table orders: one row per change, never updated or removed; the input of the gold layer

Partitioned by day of `_changed_at`.

| `order_id` | bigint | no | Order identifier, the source table's primary key |

## silver.products

Products that can be ordered, with their unit price. Append-only version history of source table products: one row per change, never updated or removed; the input of the gold layer

Partitioned by day of `_changed_at`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | bigint | no | Product identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `product_name` | string | no | Name of the product |
| `barcode` | string | no | Barcode of the product |
| `unity_price` | decimal(38,10) | no | Unit price of the product, decoded from Debezium's variable-scale decimal |
| `is_active` | boolean | yes | Whether the product is active |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | yes | Time the source row was last updated (source wall clock read as UTC) |
| `updated_by` | bigint | yes | Identifier of the user who last updated the source row |
